ordering: Write this protocol before reading any source training outcome. All registered source training files must exist before target evaluation.
eligibility: Require an explicitly submitted, freshly confirmed source model. Keep every registered source failure or absence as unavailable in both conditions.
frozen: Copy the submitted model's original fitting workspace and dependencies. Keep source code and source fitting data. The existing predictor executor calls its original fit function, if present, on that same source fitting view.
refit: Copy the same original model context independently, replace the paid fitting view with 72 target rows, and execute its existing fit function. No fit function means unavailable, with the attempted target acquisition retained in costs. No author, fitting algorithm, candidate choice or code revision is supplied.
cost_scope: Source learning costs appear once per registered source. Target training and terminal observations are separate. Charged computation quotes terminal candidate-row scoring and target refit training rows before execution, retaining the quote on execution failure; an explicit no-fit result releases that quote. Completed scored_rows and target_fit_rows are reported separately. Arbitrary Python fit internals, source refitting and context copying are represented by measured time, not a claimed FLOP total. Failed executions retain their elapsed time.
scope: Finite-control deterministic development transfer to new physical parameters. This isolates frozen predictor structure with or without local refitting. It does not establish autonomous method reuse, learned meta-priors or an advantage over an ordinary Code agent given the same executable archive.
